name: Reject Reason 2 Code
definition: Reason of transmission of a rejection message in response to a request or an advice.

UNPR.name: Unable To Process
UNPR.definition: Not possible to process the message, for instance the security module is unavailable, the hardware is unavailable, or there is a problem of resource.

PARS.name: Parsing Error
PARS.definition: Invalid message: At least one of the data element or data structure is not present, the format, or the content of one data element or one data structure is not correct.

SECU.name: Security
SECU.definition: Security error (for example an invalid key or an incorrect MAC value).

INTP.name: Initiating Party
INTP.definition: Invalid identification data for the sender.

RCPP.name: Recipient Party
RCPP.definition: Invalid identification data for the the receiver.

VERS.name: Protocol Version
VERS.definition: Version of the protocol couldn't be supported by the recipient.

MSGT.name: Message Type
MSGT.definition: Type of message the recipient receives is unknow or unsupported.
